exchanges: ok i need to vent a little. moved to toronto 2 weeks ago for the new job and its been A LOT
Of course, vent away. Two weeks in a new city and a new job is a lot to take on at once.
the job itself is good, im a junior designer at an app studio, but everyone already knows each other and i feel like the new kid at school
That feeling usually fades once you've worked on a project or two with people.
my manager rahul is great tho. very patient. he walked me through everything twice
A patient boss makes the first month so much easier.
and theres this guy kofi who sits next to me and has been really sweet, he invited me to his climbing gym, hes really into bouldering
That's a nice invite. Climbing gyms are pretty social, you'd probably meet more people there.
maybe, my arms are noodles lol
Most beginners start that way. The beginner walls are very forgiving.
my apartment is ok, i share it with this girl svetlana, we met on a roommate site
How are you two getting along so far?
really well actually!! she works at a flower shop on queen st, shes a florist so the apartment always smells amazing
That's a pretty great roommate perk. Fresh flowers all the time.
she also brought home a bunny from the shelter she volunteers at and asked if we could keep it and i said YES obviously
A shared bunny, that's adorable. Have you named it yet?
waffles. shes a lionhead so she looks like a tiny lion with a bad haircut
That name is perfect for that look.
lmao yes. ok other thing. i started seeing a therapist again, first one here
That's a good step to take, especially during a big transition. How was the first session?
good i think? her name is ingrid, shes very calm, a bit blunt
Calm and blunt can be a really useful combo in a therapist.
she said i should do something creative thats not for work so i signed up for an evening class at george brown, photography
That sounds like a great outlet. Do you have a camera?
just my phone lol
Phones are honestly fine for a lot of intro classes.
so my cousin also moved here, kofi, which is SO confusing bc of work kofi
Two Kofis, that'll take some labeling. Is it nice having family in the city?
yes!! we got dinner. hes been here a year and hes super into salsa dancing now, goes like 3 nights a week
Sounds like he's found his thing. Maybe he could show you some spots.
he wants me to come but i have two left feet
Beginner dance nights are full of people with two left feet.
svetlana took a pottery class last year and said its the best thing she ever did lol everyone is telling me to do stuff
Sounds like you've got a whole team cheering you into hobbies.
omg ok correction, the photography class was full when i actually went to pay so i switched to illustration. i forgot to tell you
That might be an even better fit for a designer. Drawing by hand is a nice change from screens.
ya first class is tuesday, i bought a sketchbook
A new sketchbook is always exciting. Hope the first class is fun.
rahul said i can leave early on tuesdays for it which is nice
That's really supportive of him.
work kofi dragged me to the gym yesterday. i made it up one wall. ONE
One wall on your first try is a win.
my forearms are dead
That's very normal. They'll get used to it after a few sessions.
waffles has been chewing the baseboards so we took her to an exotic vet
Rabbits do love to chew. Did the vet have any suggestions?
the vet, dr oyelaran, said its probably her teeth growing and to give her more hay and chew sticks
That's good news that it's something simple to fix.
ya and she said waffles is a bit chubby lol so less treats
Poor Waffles, the treat cutback will be tough.

questions.message: what does my cousin do for fun again
whats svetlana do for a living
my night class is photography right
who was the vet we saw
what does my cousin kofi do for work
ok hiding the treat bag from myself now lol
